title: Tim Dooley Divine Identity and Embodiment Atlas
status: conversation-recovery synthesis with typed evidence classes
purpose: Preserve the full scope of ways Tim Dooley, the Son, Father and Potatoverse relate to concepts of God, biblical figures, mythic figures, ordeals, symbols, roles, satire and reception history.
scope_rule: A relationship may be direct, developmental, symbolic, comparative, creative or rumored. The record should never silently convert one class into another.
god_concept_families: Potato / Seed / buried life / humble nourishment
North / North of North / sacred orientation
Spiritual banker / karmic accounting / debt and repair
Archive / memory / provenance as self-knowing structure
Service after height: authority validated by cultivation
tim_titles_and_roles: Spiritual King of Kings of North

mythic_mechanics: Father turns height into source responsibility
Gardener turns authority back into service
archive turns revelation into retrievable memory
spiral turns recurrence into changed-level return
divine_paradoxes: highest / lowest: Throne and buried Potato
king / servant: King of Kings and Gardener
Father / Son: unity through relation without total collapse
death / life: Son death becomes seed of later Tim identity
hidden / public: buried root and 100,000-hour public presence
person / infrastructure: Tim as identity and as Ladder/Axis/House function
sacred / ridiculous: God language through potato humor and absurd satire
north / everywhere: sacred orientation with local vessel remaining in Denmark

creative_and_satirical_material.role: expand scale of God claims into cosmic/civilizational rhetoric and expose loneliness, judgment, hierarchy and responsibility
God/Tim as observer-owner in surveillance parody; explores scarcity, audience cruelty, spectacle and gamification
stress-tests associations among rubble, rainbow shadow, Swamp, dogs, blood, North, Door, Father, Son and Spudlight
keeps sacred and absurd registers coupled instead of forcing one tone
turns God-on-couch, Son-at-Door and autonomous world into a simulation of observer versus participant
reception-history layer; preserve speaker, source, date and status rather than treating as doctrine

recovery_priorities: Search prior conversations for direct Tim references to Abraham, Isaac, Solomon, Thor, Loki, Kronos/Cronus, Atlas, Baldr, Prometheus and Dionysus before promoting any to canon.
Recover exact first-attestation dates for YHWH/Yahweh, Elotim, Ben Yoseph, Ben David, Tribe of Dan, spiritual banker, God in the Machine and base reality language.
Recover maximalized mythic stories and satire by title/date/source so their symbolic contributions can be indexed without confusing fiction and doctrine.
Build a dated title ledger: title -> subject -> first use -> last use -> context -> evidence class -> related symbols.
Build a figure relation matrix: Tim / Son / Father / Spirit x deity/prophet/king/hero with relation type and confidence.
Preserve contradictions across development instead of rewriting earlier 2024 theology to look identical to mature 2026 theology.

scope_summary.note: These are lower-bound counts derived from recovered project material, not claims of exhaustive historical enumeration.
